report.summary: Reviewed chunk 5 of ollama.py (lines 481-580): implements tool dispatch (list_dir, read_file, write_file), rescue logic with decision schema, and structured RescueOutcome. Claims about git diff, path resolution, backups, rescue outcomes, and force_json are checked against visible code.

write_file | low | self._backups setdefault with target.read_bytes() may read large files | Verify files are reasonable size or add size check
write_file | medium | parent loop may not stop if root is not an ancestor of target | Confirm root is always ancestor of target

_schema_rescue | medium | force_json used but no import visible; may be from native_chat | Confirm native_chat supports force_json parameter

handoff.purpose: Tool dispatch (git diff, list_dir, read_file, write_file) and rescue schema/execution

symbols.name: git_diff
symbols.note: Defined as local closure inside another function; runs git diff with subprocess, returns truncated stdout/stderr or error message.

symbols.name: list_dir
symbols.note: Branch in tool dispatch; lists directory entries sorted, returns error if target is not a directory.

symbols.name: read_file
symbols.note: Branch in tool dispatch; reads file text up to MAX_READ_CHARS, returns error on OSError.

symbols.name: write_file
symbols.note: Branch in tool dispatch; writes file after backup, path_write_blocked check, and directory creation. Returns OK or error.

symbols.name: _decision_schema
symbols.note: Static method returning a JSON schema dict with action enum (tool names + 'finish'), optional path/content, required action.

symbols.name: _schema_rescue
symbols.note: Re-asks last turn with constrained JSON schema; returns RescueOutcome with reason codes (RESCUE_UNREACHABLE, RESCUE_MALFORMED, RESCUE_FINISHED).

observations.what: git_diff uses subprocess.run with shell=False (default) but args["path"] is used unsanitized in the command list; potential command injection if path contains spaces or special characters.
path_write_blocked is called with rel (resolved path) but the docstring says 'guard the RESOLVED path'; it's unclear if the function expects a string or Path. This is a design assumption.
self._backups.setdefault with target.read_bytes() could read entire file into memory; for large files this could be a performance issue.

The parent loop for directory creation may not stop if root is not an ancestor of target; the condition 'if root in parent.parents' may be True but the loop continues until parent == root, which may never happen if root is not an ancestor.
RescueOutcome, RESCUE_UNREACHABLE, RESCUE_MALFORMED, RESCUE_FINISHED are not defined in this chunk; they must be imported or defined elsewhere.
force_json parameter in native_chat is not imported/defined in this chunk; it may be a custom argument to native_chat.
keep_alive_value() is not defined in this chunk; it must be imported or defined elsewhere.
The return statement at the end of _schema_rescue is incomplete in this chunk (no closing parenthesis); it may be a truncation artifact or a syntax error.
